enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Insightful Spell Resistance +10: +10 Insight bonus to Spell Resistance.
Insightful Fortification +43%: +43% Insight bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.

Manslayer: While wearing this item, your weapon attacks gain the devastating ability to defeat a humanoid opponent with a single decisive blow. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit a humanoid target will be killed. Powerful humanoids may resist the vorpal strike and instead take 100 points of damage until they have been sufficiently weakened.
Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.

Nearly Complete: Ability Score: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to the forges on the upper floor of Gravenhollow and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.text: This item can be upgraded with one of the following:

children.tooltip: Charisma +6: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Constitution +6: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Dexterity +6: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Intelligence +6: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Strength +6: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Wisdom +6: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
